Name: Cook Showdown
Description:
小镇中每周举行一次料理比赛。
A cooking competition is held every week in the town.


[size=5]安装方法：[/size]
方法一：先安装[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]和[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]ContentPatcher[/url]，然后将本模组的压缩文件解压到Mods文件夹中即可。
方法二：通过[url=https://smallfire.cn]小火星露谷管理器[/url]中搜索“Cook Showdown”进行一键安装。

[size=5]Installation method:[/size]
Install SMAPI﻿ and ContentPatcher﻿ first, then unzip the compressed file of this module into the Mods folder.

[size=5]游戏说明：
[/size]社区中心剧情后第二天镇长会来告知你，每周星期天的12点到15点会在酒吧二楼举行料理对决比赛。获胜可以获得丰厚的奖励。
目前还没有支持多人游戏。

[size=5]Game Instructions:[/size]
The next day after the community center cutscene,  the mayor will inform you the next day that a cooking battle competition will be held on the second floor of the bar every Sunday from 12 PM to 3 PM. Winning the competition will grant you generous rewards.
There is currently no support for multiplayer.

源代码（source code）：https://github.com/435201823/CookingShowdown
